requirements: This is an ARTICLE directory, not a listing form - the 'listing' is a published article containing your link(s)

Free author account required: valid email + password; strict ONE account per author (multiple accounts = permanent ban); real names only (no company/promotional names); up to 10 pen names allowed under one account

Article rules: English only; 850-6,000 words (1,200-2,500 recommended); original content you own rights to; NO AI-generated content (permanent ban); no promotional/advertorial content; title <=100 chars in Title Case
Link rules: NO links in the first two paragraphs; up to 10 links in the body + 1 in the author signature; ALL links are nofollow; new authors (<10 posts) get external links 'redirected'
Images JPG only via their media manager; max 3 revisions per article; max 3% keyword density; max 20% bold text
preparation: A genuinely original, non-promotional English article of 850+ words related to your product's domain
Real author name and email for the account
Your target link placed after paragraph two and in the author signature (all nofollow regardless)
Optional JPG images for the media manager
workflow: Register a free author account at https://www.sooperarticles.com/author-signup.php (activate via email if prompted)
Submit the article through the author dashboard, following the word count, formatting, and link-placement rules
Editorial review takes 1-2 weeks; they email on publication or with revision requests (max 3 revisions)
Article goes live with your nofollow links and author signature
watchFor: Hard bans: AI-generated content, plagiarized content, advertorials, multiple accounts, <850 words, or links in the first two paragraphs cause immediate rejection or permanent bans
All links are nofollow AND new authors' external links are 'redirected' until ~10 posts - SEO value is limited; value is referral/authority, not link equity
ToS grants Sooper Articles a perpetual, royalty-free license to reproduce and distribute your content to partner sites
Age requirement 16+; content may be republished elsewhere with 'Article Source: www.sooperarticles.com' attribution
Premium 'publishing packages' are mentioned for promotional content - separate paid route via contact
countsAsLive: The article is published at a public sooperarticles.com URL under the author byline, with the author signature link
unknowns: Whether signup requires email activation before first submission
Current price of the premium publishing packages for promotional content
Whether article pages still pass any link value (all links documented as nofollow)
